title: Give each card its own file so parallel pull requests stop conflicting on board.json
notes: board.json is in 82 of 115 conflicted merges. Every card branch rewrites the one file. Alternative: .dashboard/cards/<id>.json plus a small board.json for columns and order. Cost large. (docs/review/2026-11-01.md W1)

comments.body: Shipped in #206: board kept as .dashboard/board/columns.json + cards/<id>.json with an order field; board.json read forever, moved on first write; create-task, ship and review commit through BOARD_PATHSPECS; watcher recursive with snapshot compare. Migration tested on this repo's 202-card board; add/add and move/move merges proven conflict-free. Running app needs rebuild and restart after merge.
